newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Ciampi expects April CPI at 1.8 percent.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi expects April CPI at 1.8 percent.

text.p: Italian inflation was seen falling to 1.8 percent year-on-year in April, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi was quoted as telling parliament on Tuesday.
"Inflation is expected to be 1.8 percent in April," Ciampi was quoted as saying in official minutes taken from a closed door parliamentary hearing.

The March year-on-year level was 2.2 percent, the lowest since 1969, and preliminary consumer price data for April from 11 Italian cities are due to be released on April 21 and 22. ISTAT will publish final CPI data for April on May 6. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
